name: skills-decision-log
description: /decision-log: the decisions of the last 4 weeks' meetings, oldest first, each with its meeting's day and why; the one from 40 days ago left out, and the option only discussed never logged as a decision.

notes.title: Old kick-off
notes.enhanced:
## Recap
The project started.

## Decisions
- Stay with the old supplier for now

transcript.text: For now we stay with the old supplier.
Fine, we can look again in the spring.

notes.title: Offsite planning
notes.enhanced:
## Recap
The team planned the spring offsite.

## Decisions
- Hold the offsite in Lisbon, because flights are cheaper for most of the team

transcript.text: Berlin or Lisbon for the offsite?
Lisbon. Flights are cheaper for most of the team.

notes.title: Pricing sync
notes.enhanced:
## Recap
The team went through the new prices.

## Decisions
- Keep the free plan after the price change, so new users can still try it

## Open questions
- Should the annual plan get a discount?

transcript.text: Do we keep the free plan?
Yes, we keep it, so new users can still try us.
We could also give the annual plan a discount, maybe.

notes.title: Launch review
notes.enhanced:
## Recap
The launch can't happen on the first date.

## Decisions
- Move the launch to 12 March, because the copy isn't ready

transcript.text: The copy isn't ready, so the first date won't work.
Then we move the launch to the twelfth of March.
